metadata.title: A Gage-type estimate for the $p$-fundamental tone and applications to submanifolds
metadata.abstract: A generalization of the classical Gage's upper bound for the fundamental tone of the Laplacian on complete non-compact Riemannian manifolds to the $p$-Laplacian context is obtained. As an application, upper estimates for the $p$-fundamental tone of complete non-compact submanifolds of space forms with constant nonpositive sectional curvature, and for a class of product spaces, are presented.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 文章把完整非紧黎曼流形上 Gage 的 Laplacian 基频上界推广到 p-Laplacian，并应用于非正曲率空间形式的子流形及某些乘积空间。
analysis.breakthrough: 得到非线性谱问题中的几何上界及相应应用。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未给出完整常数与几何假设，需正文判断估计的锋利性。 本条依据官方摘要与评论整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立核查记录为准。
analysis.priorityReason: 属于谱几何实用估计，对相关专题有参考价值。
